name: Kiyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kiyama town emblem in maroon: a stylised device of a winged top above a ring with a mountain, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Kiyama, a town in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1968.

features.role: Kiyama town emblem — a stylised device of a winged top above a ring with a mountain, like a bird
